question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is** "motorized".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Motorized" **refers to a vehicle or device that is powered by a motor or engine, such as a car or a scooter. (एक वाहन या उपकरण जो मोटर या इंजन द्वारा संचालित होता है, जैसे कार या स्कूटर)

 
 
• **Example**: *I loved that **motorized**__ wheelchair. * 
 
 
 
• In the given context, the options are related to modes of transportation.
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.
 
• Correct passage:

The automobile industry is one of the __leading__ industries at the global level. It plays a crucial role in the development of the global economy because of the high revenues and increased customer demands. The automobile industry helps to __foster__ economic development of the country; therefore, it is widely recognised as a major economic sector. The automobile industry consists of multiple companies __specialised__ in car manufacturing, as well as the ones involved in marketing and distribution of automobile products, such as cars, buses, vans, trucks, motorcycles, mopeds and __**motorized**__ bicycles. The global automobile industry incorporates several large car manufacturers' blocs that work ______ (5) ______ at the global level. 

41:T1392,

The correct answer is** "collaboratively."**<br /&g
